name: com.scriptiii/ai-tools
title: Scriptiii AI Tools
description: Search 222+ AI tools by task, category and price model; read individual listings.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search approved AI tools by name, tagline, tag or category.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Read one approved tool and its public listing details.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List directory categories and approved tool counts.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List tags and approved tool counts.

tools.name: get_site_stats
tools.description: Read public listing, vote and badge click totals.

tools.name: get_seo_status
tools.description: Read canonical site discovery URLs and indexable page counts.

tools.name: get_legal_page
tools.description: Read the currently published legal page revision.

tools.name: suggest_website
tools.description: Suggest a website for an editor to review. Public: no key needed, three suggestions per client per hour. The website is queued for review and never published by this call — an editor approves it, and pricing or description you pass is not verified. Returns the ticket id, or the existing slug when the site is already listed.

name.description: Defaults to a name read from the domain.

tagline.description: One sentence on what it does.

description.description: What the site is, in the agent's own words.

category.description: An existing category name, or a new section name. Defaults to Other.

pricingType.description: Only when the page states it; unverified otherwise.

tools.name: list_comparisons
tools.description: List pinned comparisons with their note, actor and creation time.
